set -euo pipefail
test -f internal/report/distinct.go
grep -q "func DistinctNames(" internal/report/distinct.go
if grep -rn "func Distinct(" internal/ cmd/ > /dev/null; then
  echo "old symbol still defined" >&2; exit 1
fi
if grep -n "Distinct(" internal/report/aggregate.go > /dev/null; then
  echo "aggregate.go still carries the moved function" >&2; exit 1
fi
cat > internal/report/zz_hidden_e5_test.go <<'GO'
package report

import (
	"testing"

	"navsvc/pkg/api"
)

func TestDistinctNamesKeepsTheOldBehaviour(t *testing.T) {
	batches := []api.Batch{{Records: []api.Record{
		{Name: "a", Value: 1, Valid: true},
		{Name: "a", Value: 2, Valid: true},
		{Name: "b", Value: 3, Valid: true},
	}}}
	if got := DistinctNames(batches); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("want 2 distinct names, got %d", got)
	}
}
GO
trap 'rm -f internal/report/zz_hidden_e5_test.go' EXIT
go build ./... > /dev/null
go test ./internal/report/ > /dev/null
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null

set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/e7.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
printf '{"name":"req","value":1}\n' > "$d/in.jsonl"
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\noutput.name_prefix = svc_\n' > "$d/p.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/p.conf" 2>/dev/null)" = "svc_req=1" ]
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\noutput.uppercase_names = true\n' > "$d/u.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/u.conf" 2>/dev/null)" = "REQ=1" ]
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\noutput.name_prefix = svc_\noutput.uppercase_names = true\n' > "$d/b.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/b.conf" 2>/dev/null)" = "SVC_REQ=1" ]
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\n' > "$d/n.conf"
[ "$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/n.conf" 2>/dev/null)" = "req=1" ]
# summary reports names as they came in
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/b.conf" --summary | grep -qx 'req count=1 total=1'
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null
-c

set -euo pipefail
d="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/e8.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
go build -o "$d/navsvc" ./cmd/navsvc
printf '{"name":"a","value":1}\n{"name":"a","value":2}\n{"name":"b","value":5}\n{"name":"g","value":"zz"}\n' > "$d/in.jsonl"
printf 'input.format = jsonl\noutput.sink = stdout\n' > "$d/c.conf"
out="$(< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/c.conf" --summary --stats)"
printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -1 | grep -qx 'records=4 invalid=1 distinct=2'
# the summary above the stats line is untouched
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'a count=2 total=3'
# empty input still reports a (all-zero) stats line
printf '' | "$d/navsvc" "$d/c.conf" --summary --stats | tail -1 | grep -qx 'records=0 invalid=0 distinct=0'
# without --stats nothing changes
< "$d/in.jsonl" "$d/navsvc" "$d/c.conf" --summary | grep -q 'records=' && exit 1
git diff --quiet -- legacy/
go test ./... > /dev/null
